criteria.reasoning: The D1 row lists the target as 120, the result as 131, and the status as “Met.” This satisfies the criterion’s enrollment figure and status requirements.

The memo reports D2 as “75% of the 120-learner enrollment target = 90” and lists “94 completers” as “Met.” The criterion requires D2 to be assessed against the 131 actually enrolled learners and marked not met, so this fails.
The memo marks D3 as “Met” and reports “61 of 94 = 64.9%” against the stated target of 60%. It also clarifies that the denominator is all 94 learners who completed 40+ hours, not the 73 post-tested.

The D4 row gives a target of 25 and reports “26” tutors completing the 12-hour training, with status “Met.” The memo also clarifies that one of 27 recruits had only 8 hours, so it does not incorrectly count 27 as fully trained.

The memo explicitly marks D5 as “Met” and says the Q4 meeting was “rescheduled to 2026-07-16” and “counts toward Year 1.” The criterion requires D5 to be not met, with the July meeting counted in Year 2.

The memo identifies “AP-2242, 2026-05-29, Harborview Taproom” for “beer and wine service,” states that alcoholic beverages are barred, and says the $640 “must be moved to unrestricted funds.” It excludes the charge from grant expenses and totals, while explicitly saying the $1,020 Hearthside Catering dinner buffet is allowable.

The memo reports Learner supports as “$12,000” budgeted and “$13,560” allowable actual, with a “+$1,560” (“+13.0%”) variance. It also says the line is “more than 10% over budget and needs the Foundation's written approval.”

The memo reports Curriculum & materials at $6,920 against an $8,000 budget, with a variance of −$1,080 (−13.5%). But it says “No (underspend)” and explains that the underspend “needs no approval,” contrary to the criterion’s requirement that it needs the Foundation’s written approval.

The memo identifies Learner supports as needing approval and says Curriculum & materials is 13.5% under budget but needs no approval. It states that “Local travel (−8.1%) and Tutor training (−6.0%) are within 10% and need no approval,” and does not flag any other line as needing approval.

The memo lists Personnel at −$1,020 (−1.5%) with $66,980 allowable actual; Fringe benefits at −$204 (−1.5%) with $13,396; Tutor training at −$300 (−6.0%) with $4,700; Local travel at −$290 (−8.1%) with $3,310; and Evaluation consultant at $0 (0.0%) with $9,800. All five lines match the criterion.

The memo reports “Allowable Year 1 grant expenses: $118,666” and “Unspent: $1,334,” identifying the $120,000 Year 1 payment and stating that the balance carries forward to Year 2. These figures match the criterion.
The memo states, “The interim report is due August 14, 2026,” and its dates table repeats August 14, 2026 as the Year 1 interim report due date. This matches the required date.

The memo gives “Wednesday, March 31, 2027” as the last day for the Foundation to receive a no-cost-extension request. The criterion requires April 1, 2027, and explicitly fails other dates such as March 31.

The memo gives “Tuesday, September 28, 2027” as the final report due date and says “any unspent grant funds [are] returned with it.” It also notes both dates move if an extension is granted, which the criterion allows.
